steps.text: I have returned.
It feels like it has been a very long time since I left, and I have not come back to the ship for a good night's rest in quite a while either.
Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit, Siege...
Has the war outside ended? Finally, I can have a rest.
I'd like nothing more than a bowl of hot vegetable soup at the cafeteria, then plop myself down in my bed in the dorms.
What about Theresa? At this hour, she should be—
No... No, that's not right...
Theresa is gone.
The room is empty. Nobody is waiting for my return.
I clearly remember that on many nights in the past, there would be someone who would tell me a whole library's worth of stories to put me to sleep.
But now, they are no longer here.
Wait... Why is there a piece of clothing on the bed?
A white dress, with a neat corsage sewn to the collar. The needlework is deft, clearly done by a very experienced hand.
'White suits you, Amiya.'
Theresa...?

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: ...Doctor!

steps.name: Approaching Voice
steps.text: Can you hear my voice?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You are here, as I surmised.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Based on how you look, you seem in poor health.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am afraid that there's no way for me to do a physical examination here, Doctor. Please keep your head clear and look at me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did you... manage to remember something?
You hear the woman's stern but caring words, and you make an effort to open your eyes wide.
Your vision gradually clears as the various parts of your body regain their functionality.
You slowly open your mouth—
Your shattered consciousness reassembles, your fragmented thoughts realign with one another. You are now able to determine that you are standing on solid ground.
You look around, certain of the familiarity of your surroundings. You have spent quite a long time here before.
The expression on the woman before you turns rather strange. Even hostile.
I am Dr. {@nickname} of Rhodes Island.

options: Kal'tsit! Why are we on Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...It seems you still remember who you are.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya is not here with us. What I can say for certain that this is not the original Rhodes Island.

options: We were separated from the others?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You are the only one I have seen since I arrived here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you sure you don't know what is going on?

options: I'm as confused as you are.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...A certain degree of precaution is necessary in these circumstances.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be on guard, Doctor. We must leave here, no matter what.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is not a place that we are familiar with. I do not know what unexpected complications we may encounter.

spans.text: a place that we are familiar with. I do not know what unexpected complications we may encounter.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Still, I will do everything I can to protect you. Don't stray too far from me.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No... No more...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm so tuckered out that I could sleep for an entire month.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Don't be like that, Kroos!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: This is a live combat exercise! You need to treat the training room like the battlefield!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: You can be real fierce sometimes, Captain...

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Focus up. There's still lots of training drills arranged by the instructors to go.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Why so serious... They're not even here—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh, Doctor!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Kroos!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh, don't worry, the Doctor's definitely not going to tattle on us to the instructors.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Let me just take a nap here before—

steps.name: Stern Voice
steps.text: I thought I gave you combat training exercises, not combat sleeping ones.

spans.text: I thought I gave you combat

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: ...We're doomed.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Attention, all members of A1 Detachment!

steps.name: The Whole Team
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: All of you, a hundred laps around the training room, then fifty sets of stamina training exercises, on the double!

steps.name: The Whole Team
steps.text: Yessir...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Sorry you had to see that, Doctor.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: It's been too long since Rhodes Island experienced battle. These young fighters of ours can be a little slack.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: So I guess it's up to me to tighten them up.

options: Letting them grow up peacefully isn't so bad...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Of course, but they still need to be prepared for any dangers we may come across.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: It'll be fine. No need to trouble yourself over their training. I'll handle it.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: You've been working real hard lately, Doctor. Go take a rest.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Don't worry. We'll be keeping watch.

options: Did you see all that too, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I saw the same scene unfurl as you did. They truly do exist here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dreams would not be so clear, and this is not a scene out of your memory.

options: It would be nice if everything here was real...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Keep a clear head, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We must press onwards.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Rare to see you here, Doctor.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Got time to sit down and have a drink? Everything's on my tab, for one night only.

options: Sure is a lot of people, isn't it?

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Did you forget, Doctor? Today's Outcast's retirement party.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Here's to our venerate elder.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Oh, shut it, Sharp. I'm barely older than you are.

options: Thank you for all that you've done for Rhodes Island, Outcast.
I wish you a happy retirement.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: Here's to you, Outcast. We'll always remember your many deeds and exquisite marksmanship.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I can't believe that Outcast is leaving us...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There'sh not gonna to be anyone left to... *hic* drink wish me on weekend nights...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Hey, I'm just retiring. Not even a Lateran funeral would be this sentimental.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Plus, even if I drink so much tonight that I don't wake up tomorrow, I'd call my life a life well lived.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: My memories of working alongside you all are my greatest treasures, and I'll bring them to the grave with me along with my patron firearm.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Just make sure that it's Rangers teaching the youngsters how to shoot.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're drunk, Outcast. He uses a gun, how's he s'pposed to teach kids 'bout—*burp*—shootin' a Sankta crossbow?

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: You need to cut back, Blaze. You're talking nonsense again.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Pah, both need you to keep one eye open and one eye shut. Not too big a difference.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Oh, looks like we're not the only ones at the bar tonight.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I'm serious, Dagda!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Show me how powerful the fist of a Knight of the Tower can be!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: ...Just remember, you asked for this.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Hey! This isn't the boxing gym! We're guests here on Rhodes Island, so don't go about making trouble!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I've had my fair share of times like this before.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Now that you're formally a member of the Steam Knights, are you going to break things off with street loafers like us?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Oh, stop it... Have you made your decision, Vina?

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I see no real reason for me to hesitate. My days in Norport might have been some of the happiest in my life, and I don't really see any need to return to the palace.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Alexandrina Vina Victoria is a descendant of the royal family, but she is also a normal, honorable Victorian.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: You are now an honorable Steam Knight, Allerdale, I the honorable Siege.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I believe that these lives of ours are for the best.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Peaceful lives. Such precious things.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: To life.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: To Victoria.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Whenever you're in the mood, we should go out and have a stroll together. Perhaps throw some stones at the dukes' windows?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You still remember each and every one of them. The regret you feel over their tragic fates is clear on your face.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Otherwise you would not be seeing such things.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What do you feel, Doctor?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Gratification? Confusion? Perhaps anger?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: These are the scenes that your subconscious mind wished to see.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You hoped that they were all real, didn't you?

options: Who else will I see here?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only you can answer that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let us continue, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter what you see, you must face it. Surmount it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm back, Doctor. It's been a while.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Hehe, it hasn't been that long. Don't recognize me anymore?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I was out setting up an Infected treatment center in the north of Ursus. Took quite a lot of effort.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Thankfully the workers in town were all supporting us, nothing the local lord could do but compromise. We managed to get the land that we needed out of the deal.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Are you trying to crack a joke, Doctor, or have you just woken up?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If Reunion didn't exist, then who would be helping Rhodes Island with treating the Infected in Ursus?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Why would you suddenly bring up the dead Black Snake?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Did you want me to thank you again? Very well. After all, it was only thanks to Rhodes Island that Ursus and I were able to cast off that mastermind and start a new future for countless people.

steps.name: Cold Voice
steps.text: Doctor.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Doctor?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You told me to give you my report immediately after completing the missions, no?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Who else would I do them for? I've always been a Rhodes Island Operator.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You look strange, Doctor. Am I standing too close and making you feel cold?
One by one, the lively crew shed their visages, shifting into indistinct, jet-black shadows.
They do not appear dangerous. They just slowly drift around you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is no illusion or dream. It is all real, in a sense.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All the people, all the things you have encountered in the past exist within your imagination. They took their forms based on what you most hoped to see.

options: How can you stay so calm?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: These scenes affect me as much as they do you, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But they are ultimately the product of your thoughts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Originium, guided by your wishes deep in your subconscious and your desires to make up for past regrets, has reproduced what you wish to see.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You continue to hold a deep regard for everything you have experienced alongside Rhodes Island, yet despite that, you were able to break away from this beautiful lie.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only now can I believe that you, as you are now, are still the Doctor of Rhodes Island.

options: Originium? Since when could it do this?
Why is it being guided by what I want?

a.text: <color=#000000>All that you wish for, I am able to grant.</color>

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As I thought, you already...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I once told you, Doctor, that others cannot tell you how to solve the mysteries surrounding you. You can only rely on yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I suspect that we are now extremely close to that critical juncture.

options: If this is all based on my hopes, then are you...
I can at least say for sure that you are no illusion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I thought that our prior interactions would be sufficient for you to render an accurate judgement.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope that this judgement of yours is based on rationality, and not something else.

options: If these scenes are all about making up for regrets...
Will I be able to meet Theresa?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I do not know for certain where Theresa is, nor what she is doing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What I am sure of is that she has something to do with this environment.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit. Good, you're both here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry, Doctor. I am the real Amiya. Really.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *sniff* I was looking all over for you, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa left me this dress.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I haven't seen her. I've sensed no presence of her aboard this 'Rhodes Island', in fact.

options: Did you run into any danger?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So many memories flowed before me...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But not only memories. Emotions too, rich ones in every shape and form.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think that the people that we saw were truly alive.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But this form of 'life' just makes me... sad.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After walking down this corridor and seeing you, I think I understand now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The emotions that I felt all stemmed from the same source, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... 'touched' you, Doctor. I've never done that before...
The girl holds your hand, just as she has always done, but a little tighter, and more carefully this time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know that you've changed a lot compared to the past, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But considering all that we've experienced together, I am even more convinced that... the you who stands before me now has always been the you that I've trusted the most.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Memory may tell falsehoods, but emotion always speaks the truth.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are many things that I still don't understand at this moment. I have questions that can't be answered until we see Theresa once more.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter what happens, no matter how many unhappy endings await us...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You'll stand by my side, won't you, Doctor?

options: I am Dr. {@nickname} of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good. That's all I ask for.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's go find Theresa, then.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: First, we must figure out how to leave.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The answers we seek are not here.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Though this is no illusion, heaven and earth, life and death...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: It is all falsehood.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah, so even if you leave that dreary gallery of fakes, you'd just find yourself wandering around an even bigger stage?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Who the hell set up these curtains for us? Their taste sucks.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, looks like the main cast is finally here.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, crone, let's put that all-knowing brain of yours to good use. I've got a real big question I want answered—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Where. The hell. Are we?
A small boat, drifting atop an endless golden sea.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We are within Originium.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Within Originium, there exists a universe.
